name: omadev
author: Muhsin
description: Start and stop whole development projects from the bar: multiplexer workspace, dev server, browser, editor and helper apps, without duplicating anything already running.

barWidget.description: One click starts a project's multiplexer workspace, dev server, browser, editor and helper apps; one click stops them. Start attaches to whatever is already running instead of opening it twice.

schema.label: Panel width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units. Anything wider than the screen is trimmed to fit.
